notes: Five sneakers floating side-on, toe left, in one drop. Floating things: float true, centred on the stage instead of standing on a ground line, fit by width. The shoes turn round their vertical axis in mid-air.
shot: Studio product photograph of one {subject}. Seen exactly side-on from its outer side, toe pointing to the left, floating in mid-air in the centre of the frame, level. The shoe spans about 55% of the frame width, with clear empty space all around it. Plain seamless light grey backdrop, soft even studio light, no shadow on the ground. Photorealistic, crisp material detail. No logos, no brand marks, no text.
turn: Turntable shot. The floating shoe slowly rotates in mid-air around its vertical axis through one full 360-degree turn at a steady, even speed, always turning the same way, and ends exactly as it started, side-on with the toe pointing left. The camera is locked off: no camera movement, no zoom, no pan. The shoe keeps its exact shape, colours and details throughout. The plain backdrop and light stay the same.
